name: Post-Scenario Compressor
description: Summarizes the final system message after all lorebooks, cantrips, and skills have been applied. Uses a more capable model for complex compression. Triggers when the final system message exceeds 6,000 tokens.
author: GitInTheVan
prompt: Compress the following system prompt while retaining ALL critical information. This includes character definitions, world-building details, behavioral instructions, and writing guidelines. Merge redundant sections. Use concise language. Prioritize information that affects character behavior and scene setting. Output only the compressed text.
